title: The Seed

stage.name: Seed
stage.description: A seed rests in the soil: small, but holding everything it needs to begin.

intro: Every relationship starts small. Here is what a seed already holds.

questions.prompt: What is packed inside a seed?
options: A tiny baby plant and a store of food
questions.why: Every seed holds an embryo, which is a baby plant, plus stored food for its first growth.

questions.prompt: Match each part of a seed to its job.
questions.why: The coat guards the seed, the embryo grows, and the stored food feeds it until it has leaves.

questions.prompt: A seed that looks dry and still is dead.
questions.why: Seeds are alive but dormant. Some wait for years until conditions are right.

questions.prompt: A new relationship is like a seed. What helps it most at the start?
options: Leaving it to grow on its own
questions.why: Small, reliable signs of interest build trust. Big gestures can't replace everyday attention.

talk: What small hopes did each of you bring when you chose each other?
